Order.title: Order
Order.description: Customer farm produce order with customer details, items, delivery zone, and fulfillment status

orderNumber.description: Unique human-readable order number e.g. MAF-20261015-1234

customerName.description: Full name of the customer placing the order

customerEmail.description: Optional email address of the customer

deliveryAddress.description: Delivery address details including district, thana, and street address

deliveryZone.description: Delivery territory zone: kurigram_sadar, rangpur_division, or nationwide

items.description: Ordered line items with products and quantities

deliveryCharge.description: Delivery fee based on destination and cart value

discount.description: Discount applied via promotional coupon code

total.description: Grand total in BDT including delivery charge minus discounts

paymentTrxId.description: Mobile banking transaction ID if paid via bKash/Nagad

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the order

customerNotes.description: Special delivery instructions provided by customer

adminNotes.description: Internal notes added by farm management admin

courierName.description: Assigned courier service name (e.g., Steadfast, Pathao, RedX, Farm Express)

userId.description: Optional customer user ID if logged in

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp when order was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp when order was last updated

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Authorized farm administrator with permissions to view and update orders

/orders/{orderId}.description: Centralized customer orders placed from any device, accessible in real-time by admins

/admins/{adminUid}.description: List of authorized administrator accounts verified for order management
